accounts_note: Platform administration, via Better Auth's admin plugin. Impersonation keeps your admin identity — the session records who is behind it.
admin_create_account_sub: For somebody who needs to exist before they can sign in — a coach a team must name, or an address that keeps bouncing. They sign in with a code like everybody else.
admin_delete_player_confirm: Delete {player}? Their squads, event entries, attendance and guardians go with them. This cannot be undone.
admin_delete_team_confirm: Delete {team}? Its roster, coaching staff and event entries go with it. This cannot be undone.
coaching_staff_signin: Sign in to see who coaches this team.
code_sent_to: Code sent to {email}. It expires in 10 minutes.
crash_body: Something in the app broke, not your connection. Reloading usually fixes it, and we have been told what happened.
create_event_denied: Your role ({role}) does not have permission to create events.
dev_holds_nothing: no relations — sees only what is public
device_not_registered: This device is not on the list above, so nothing will reach it — even though notifications look switched on here. Turn them off and on again to register it.
devices_none: No browser is registered yet. Turn notifications on above.
discover_sub: Find tournaments, leagues, camps, and showcases. Browse by city, format, or status.
email_invite_subject: {invitedBy} invited you to join {org} on Remy Sport
email_no_address: This account has no email address, so email is off.
email_otp_body:
Your code is {otp}.

Use it to {purpose}. It expires in 10 minutes.

If you did not ask for this, ignore this email — nobody can use the
code without it.
email_row_none: No address yet — sign in with a code and it is registered for you.
email_unverified: Your address is not verified yet, so email stays off.
err_bad_date_range: The end date must be on or after the start date.
err_bad_request: That request could not be understood.
err_broadcast_occupied: Another broadcaster is already covering this game. Wait for them to stop, then try again.
err_division_in_use: Teams are registered in that division, so it cannot be removed.
err_division_mismatch: This team is {teamAgeGroup} {teamGender}; that division is {divisionAgeGroup} {divisionGender}.
err_forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
err_internal_server_error: Something went wrong at our end. Please try again.
err_no_invitation: There is no invitation to accept.
err_not_a_member: That person is not a member.
err_not_a_referee: That account is not a referee.
err_not_assigned: That referee is not on this game.
err_not_found: That does not exist, or you cannot see it.
err_not_on_roster: That player is not on this roster.
err_not_registered: That team is not entered in this event.
err_team_not_entered: That team is not entered in this event.
err_teams_in_different_divisions: Those two teams are in different divisions of this event.
err_unauthorized: Please sign in and try again.
err_unknown_user: No account has that email address.
err_venue_not_at_event: That venue is not one of this event's courts. Add it to the event first.
event_dates_hint: Leave a date empty if it is not fixed yet.
event_no_details: The organiser has not added any details yet.
event_players_hint: Camps and showcases are entered by individual players.
event_players_none_of_yours: You are not a guardian for anyone who could enter this.
event_session_register_none: Nobody is entered in this camp yet.
event_venues_none: No venues set for this event yet.
events_load_failed: Could not load events. Check your connection and retry.
everyone_on_squad: Every player is already on this squad.
fixture_confirm_remove: Remove this fixture? Its referee assignments go with it.
follow_hint: Follow to be notified about games.
follow_nothing_fires: You follow nothing yet, so none of the settings below can fire.
game_box_score_empty: No players were on either squad on this game’s date.
game_box_score_hint: Leave a count blank if it was not recorded. Zero means a recorded zero.
home_create_team: Create a team at your school
home_sub: What you are connected to, and what is next.
impersonating_as: You are viewing the platform as {email}. Your own admin session is intact.
install_ios_steps: Tap the Share button at the bottom of Safari, then choose “Add to Home Screen”. iOS gives no way for an app to open this for you.
invalid_division: That division is unavailable. Showing all divisions.
invite_co_organizer_hint: They will be asked to accept before they can help run this event.
meeting_alone: Nobody else has joined yet. They appear here when they do.
meeting_connect_failed: Could not connect to the meeting. Try again.
meeting_local_hint: Start your camera or share your screen. Your preview is silent.
meeting_none: No meetings yet. Start one and the people you invite are told straight away.
meeting_not_found: This meeting is not one of yours. Ask whoever started it to invite you.
meeting_test_connect_failed: Could not connect to the room. Try again.
meeting_test_copy_failed: Could not copy the link. Select it above and copy it manually.
meeting_test_dev_only: This meeting experiment is available in development only.
meeting_test_experiment: Two-person media test. Use headphones. This is not a private meeting service.
meeting_test_invite_hint: Open this link on the other device. Use each link in one browser only.
meeting_test_local_hint: Start your camera or share your screen. Your preview is silent.
meeting_test_peer_hint: Waiting for the other participant to start. Enable sound to hear them.
meeting_test_sign_in: Sign in to try a two-person meeting.
meeting_waiting: Waiting for {name}. Turn sound on to hear them.
meeting_when_hint: Leave it empty to meet now.
meetings_sub: Calls with other people on the platform. Anyone can ask; you decide.
name: Name
no_courts_yet: No courts assigned for this event yet.
no_live_games: No games are being played right now.
no_matching_division: No division matches this team's age group and gender.
nothing_followed_yet: You are not following anything yet.
notifications_intro: Get a notification when a game you follow tips off, changes score, or ends.
notifications_not_sessions: These are the browsers registered to receive notifications, not where your account is signed in:
org_members_denied: Only an owner or admin of this organisation can see and manage its members.
org_members_empty: Nobody belongs to this organisation yet.
org_no_teams: No teams at this school yet.
orgs_sub: Schools, clubs and federations. Open one to edit its profile or manage who belongs to it.
pending_banner: Your referee account is waiting for an administrator to approve it. You can look around in the meantime.
player_created_join_failed: The player was created, but could not be added to this squad. Retry to add the same player.
player_no_team: Not on a squad at the moment.
player_signin: Sign in to see this player. Their name, school and fixtures are not public.
player_stats_none: No box score has been kept for this player yet.
profile_signed_out_sub: Sign in to see what is yours.
profile_signed_out_why: This page is built from what you are connected to — the children you are guardian to, the teams you coach, the events you follow. Signing in is what fills it.
profile_sub: Your account: who you are here, and the people you are responsible for.
push_denied: Notifications are blocked. Allow them for this site in your browser settings.
push_event_reminder_body: Check the schedule for tip-off times.
push_native_denied: Notifications are blocked for this app. Allow them in your system settings.
push_native_limit: The app notifies you while it is open. Nothing arrives when it is closed — for alerts on a phone with the app closed, add Remy to your Home Screen and turn on notifications there.
push_native_on: Notifications are on for this app.
push_needs_install: Add Remy to your Home Screen first — iPhone and iPad only allow notifications for installed apps.
push_no_devices_note: No device is registered for push yet, so these are off. Turn on notifications above, or on another device.
push_not_configured: Notifications are not switched on for this deployment yet.
push_register_failed: The subscription was created but could not be registered with the server, so it has been undone. If you have been signed out, sign in and try again.
push_subscribe_refused: This browser refused to create a push subscription. On macOS this usually means the installed app, not Safari, has to be the one asking — the console has the exact error.
push_toggle_failed: Could not switch notifications on. If you have been signed out, sign in and try again.
push_unknown: Could not check whether notifications are on.
rank_movement_note: Movement compares this division with its table before its latest match date (UTC).
role_pending_note: A referee account is checked by an organiser before you can score games.
roster_empty: No players on this roster yet.
sample_data_note: Nothing on this screen is real — it is a preview of a feature that has no data behind it yet.
sessions_not_notifications: This is where your account is signed in, not where notifications are delivered:
sessions_note: Sessions last 30 days. Sign out anything you don't recognise.
sign_in_sub: We'll email you a code — no password needed
sign_in_to_manage_notifications: Sign in to choose what you are told about, and how.
sign_in_to_see_devices: Sign in to see where your account is being used.
tab_not_built: This section is not built yet.
teams_sub: Every squad on the platform. Open one for its roster, coaching staff and fixtures.
test_all_expired: {count} device(s) had expired and have been removed. Turn notifications off and on again to re-register this one.
test_failed: The request did not get through. If you have been signed out, sign in and try again.
test_no_devices: No devices are registered to receive push, so there was nothing to send to.
test_not_configured: This deployment has no push keys, so nothing could be sent. That is a server setting, not something you can fix here.
test_notification_body: This is what a live score will look like.
test_refused: The push service refused it for {count} device(s). Nothing will arrive — this is not your device settings.
test_sent_to_devices: Sent to {count} device(s). If nothing appears, check notification permissions for this app in your system settings.
test_tap_confirmed: You tapped a test notification and it reached the app. Delivery and opening both work on this device.
venue_multiple_live: Multiple games are live at this venue. Check the assignment.
video_audio_blocked: Your browser paused sound. Enable sound to continue.
video_broadcast_hint: Choose a camera to broadcast the game. Your browser will ask for permission.
video_broadcasting: Broadcasting. Open the Watch page on another device to see it.
video_camera_permission: Camera names appear after you allow access.
video_camera_switch_hint: Changing cameras briefly interrupts the broadcast.
video_capture_denied: Capture was not allowed. Allow access in your browser, then choose a source again.
video_capture_failed: Capture could not start. Choose a source to try again.
video_capture_unavailable: The camera or screen is unavailable. Check your device, then choose a source again.
video_fallback: Using a compatibility mode. Keep this page visible for reliable video.
video_fullscreen_failed: Fullscreen could not open. You can keep watching here or try again.
video_harness_note: A test harness. It measures how live video behaves on real phones and real networks — every session is reported, not just the ones that fail.
video_no_audio: Video is available, but sound is not supported in this browser.
video_not_configured: Live video is not switched on for this deployment yet.
video_not_permitted: Only this game's referee or the people running the event can broadcast it.
video_status_nobody_live: Nobody is broadcasting this game yet.
video_status_waiting: Connected. Waiting for somebody to broadcast this game.
video_support_failed: Could not check this browser’s video support. Try again.
video_unsupported: This browser cannot process live video. Try another browser.
video_watch_hint: Nothing appears until somebody is broadcasting this game.
whoareyou_sub: You are following along as a spectator. Tell us if you are more than that.
your_players_none: Guardian to a player? Add them here to enter them in a camp or follow their team.
